Land Details Search (Survey Number) in Telangana

Know exactly what a survey number holds — who owns it, how much, and its classification — before you engage with a seller.

Key Takeaways

  • A land details search returns the recorded owner, extent, land classification and status for a survey number.
  • It is the fastest first check before engaging a seller or paying any advance.
  • It reveals whether land is patta, assigned, government or prohibited before you go deeper.
  • Pairs with the EC, 1B and prohibited-land (22A) checks for full due diligence.
  • Done remotely with just the survey number and village.

Before any negotiation, you should know what the land records actually say about a parcel. A land details search by survey number gives you the recorded owner, extent and classification in one quick look.

JaaGa runs this search so you can confirm a seller's claims and decide whether the parcel is worth deeper due diligence.

When You Need This Search

As the very first check when you shortlist a plot or agricultural parcel.

Whenever a seller's claimed ownership or extent needs quick, independent confirmation.

How We Search

  1. 1

    Take the Survey Number

    We collect the survey number, sub-division and village/mandal.

  2. 2

    Query the Records

    We look up the parcel in the Telangana land records system.

  3. 3

    Confirm Classification

    We confirm owner, extent and whether the land is patta, assigned, government or prohibited.

  4. 4

    Summary Report

    You receive a concise report of what the records show for that survey number.

Documents Required

  • Survey number and sub-division
  • Village / mandal / district
  • Claimed owner name (if known)

Common Problems We Solve

Wrong or partial survey number

A small error returns the wrong parcel. We confirm the exact number and sub-division.

Extent mismatches

Recorded extent can differ from what a seller claims. We surface the gap immediately.

Classification surprises

Land marketed as patta may be assigned or government. The search reveals it early.

Why Land Details Search Matters

A two-minute land details search can save you from weeks of negotiation over a parcel that turns out to be government, assigned or owned by someone other than your seller. It's the cheapest, fastest guardrail in land buying.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does a land details search show?

The recorded owner, extent, land classification and status for a given survey number in the Telangana land records.

Is this enough to buy safely?

It's the first step. For a purchase you also need the EC, 1B/Adangal, prohibited-land (22A) and a title verification.

What if the owner shown isn't my seller?

That's a red flag to resolve before proceeding — we help you understand the gap and next checks.

Can you search with just a survey number?

Yes, with the survey number and village. Any additional details improve accuracy.

Can this be done remotely?

Yes, entirely over WhatsApp.
